credits.title: Shadow on the Shore
credits.overview: A photographer returns to Cappadocia, where she grew up, to search for a lost camera. As the past resurfaces, the boundaries between memory, presence, and absence begin to dissolve.

credits.title: GORA 4 GORA
credits.overview: Arif, Ceku and their child Kemo return to the planet Gora. Ceku has become the queen of the planet following the death of Amir Tocha. Kemo has graduated from the Gora Military Academy. The film, which begins with Kemo's oath-taking ceremony, concludes the story that began 25 years earlier in Gora, in Gora itself.

credits.title: Blue Cave
credits.overview: When Cem finds himself at the brink of losing the love of his life, Alara, he embarks on an expedition to the Blue Cave, Alara's most beloved archeological site, to feel close to her again.

credits.title: Istanbul Trilogy: Muhabbet
credits.overview: A man who moved away from his hometown engages in deep conversations with his friends and family while toasting, eating and celebrating life.

credits.title: The Adventures of Sukran the Lame
credits.overview: A none dialogue film about a young woman called Sukran, who has an accident when she is 10 years old and stays crippled for the rest of her life.
